en: An illustrated postcard showing a small Baroque-style chapel with a red-tiled roof, bell tower, and cross, located along a street with trees and a picket fence. In the foreground there is a kiosk or poster board covered with colorful posters. The bottom border carries printed captions identifying the location, and a black band at the very bottom right contains a logo and publisher name.
